requirements.evidence: CreateQueue trims/validates the name, defaults the slug to Str::slug(name), slugifies explicit slugs and forces is_active=true (app/Actions/CreateQueue.php:24-35); duplicate slugs become ValidationException, including the unique-index race path (CreateQueue.php:29-38, app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:31-56); UpdateQueue treats null as unchanged and ignores the queue's own slug (UpdateQueue.php:40-52); SetQueueAccess upserts/revokes with the required audit messages and no log on a no-op revoke (app/Actions/SetQueueAccess.php:30-70); QueuePolicy implements create/update/manageAccess/call including corrupted grants (app/Policies/QueuePolicy.php:20-66); the migration matches the required queue_access schema (database/migrations/2026_10_29_055451_create_queue_access_table.php:14-21); both call paths authorize (app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:32, app/Models/Ticket.php:94-112).

conventions.evidence: One Action class per use case, authorizing inside the action (CreateQueue.php:24, UpdateQueue.php:29, SetQueueAccess.php:30); authorization lives in app/Policies/QueuePolicy.php; the migration follows the generated layout and has a reversible down() (migration:38-41); QueueAccess declares #[Fillable] explicitly (app/Models/QueueAccess.php:11); docs/business-rules.md, docs/database-schema.md, docs/architecture.md and the CHANGELOG Added section are updated; Pest tests ship with the behaviour.

security.evidence: Gate authorization is the first statement in every action and both call paths (CreateQueue.php:24, UpdateQueue.php:29, SetQueueAccess.php:30, CallNextTicket.php:32, Ticket.php:109); name/slug are validated server-side (app/Actions/Concerns/ValidatesQueueAttributes.php:20-34) and permissions are whitelisted to the enum with non-string entries rejected (SetQueueAccess.php:77-89); corrupted non-array permissions deny (QueuePolicy.php:57-66); writes use fixed key sets and QueueAccess has an explicit fillable list, so there is no mass-assignment or client-trusted-ID path.

tests.evidence: New Pest suites cover the requirements and failure paths: tests/Feature/CreateQueueTest.php (roles, trimming, default/explicit slug, 255-char boundary, duplicate/race, cross-entity), UpdateQueueTest.php (parameter combinations, own/foreign slug, deactivation keeps tickets, race, denials), SetQueueAccessTest.php (grant/revoke, upsert, audit, no-op revoke, invalid permissions, entity mismatch, self-grant denial, cascades), QueuePolicyTest.php (all abilities, corrupted permissions), plus new authorization cases in CallNextTicketTest.php and IssueTicketTest.php (every CallMode, no ticket changes, inactive-before-auth, auth-before-LogicException).

simplicity.evidence: Only the two queue actions share the small ValidatesQueueAttributes trait; QueuePolicy reuses isManagerOf() (app/Policies/QueuePolicy.php:70-75); SetQueueAccess has one delete path and one upsert path (SetQueueAccess.php:45-70); no service/repository layer or speculative abstraction was introduced.

readability.evidence: Small focused methods with PHPDoc and names mirroring the task vocabulary (CreateQueue, UpdateQueue, SetQueueAccess, QueuePermission); comments explain the lock order and the upsert/cast caveat (UpdateQueue.php:33-38, SetQueueAccess.php:64-65, QueuePolicy.php:62-64); style matches the sibling Ticket/CallNextTicket code.

scope.evidence: The diff only adds the queue lifecycle actions, QueuePolicy, the QueueAccess model/factory/migration, the authorization required in the two existing call paths, and the corresponding docs/tests; there is no UI, delete action, extra permission or unrelated refactor (CHANGELOG.md:9-13, docs/architecture.md:134).

issues.explanation: The new Added bullet is separated from the preceding list items by a blank line, which is inconsistent with the rest of the entry (it makes the list loose) and with Keep a Changelog formatting.

The 'not json' dataset writes invalid JSON into queue_access.permissions; that only works when the test database stores JSON as TEXT (SQLite), while MySQL/Postgres reject the UPDATE, so this corruption case is not portable. Valid-JSON non-array payloads such as "call", 123, null and true already exercise the requirement.
The no-hard-delete guarantee is tested by globbing action filenames, which would still pass if a delete() method or delete branch were added to UpdateQueue; it is a weak proxy for the requirement.

review.summary: The change implements the queue lifecycle actions, the queue_access grant model/table/action with audit logging, and a QueuePolicy that both call paths now enforce, with broad Pest coverage and the required docs updates. Requirements, authorization and validation are handled thoroughly; the only findings are minor formatting and test-quality nits. This review is based on the diff alone, so the policy's use of User::membershipFor() and App\Models\UserRole is assumed to match the base code.
